proxy_note: Host-side float SwiGLU proxy of the routed-expert MoE; identical seeded activations through FP4-source vs W2-artifact experts isolate the weight-quantisation error. Not the real Ascend fused-MoE kernel: final quality still needs a runtime/rental to confirm.
activation_note: Plain float32 activations (no per-token INT8 act quant); both paths share them so the output delta is purely the weight-quant effect.

mixed_bit_proposal.escalation_note: byte delta assumes a bit-tight store (k bits/weight); today's pack_codes writes W3 at 2 codes/byte (4 bits/weight) and W4 at 2 codes/byte (4 bits/weight), so a W3 escalation costs the same on-disk bytes as W4 with the current packer.
